meta_description: A1 Locksmiths Nottingham provides rapid emergency lockout, lock repair and installation services. Available 24/7. Call now for same-day help.
hero_subhead: We arrive within 60 minutes, any time of day or night. No call-out charge for genuine lockouts.
services_subhead: From emergency lockouts to lock repairs and security upgrades, we handle every situation with speed and professionalism.

services.title: Emergency Lockouts
services.desc: Locked out of your home or business? We'll get you back inside quickly without damage. Available 24/7, every day of the year.

services.title: Broken Lock Repair
services.desc: Snapped keys, damaged mechanisms, and worn locks repaired or replaced on the spot. We carry a full range of locks on the van.

services.title: Lock Installation & Upgrades
services.desc: Boost your home security with high-spec locks, deadbolts, and multi-point systems. We fit British Standard locks and advise on the best option for your property.

services.title: Vehicle Lockouts & Recovery
services.desc: Locked your keys in the car? We'll open it safely and swiftly, with no damage to your paintwork or interior.

services.title: UPVC Door & Window Repairs
services.desc: Struggling handles, broken hinges, and misaligned frames fixed fast. We get your doors and windows working smoothly again.

services.title: Safe Opening & Repair
services.desc: Forgotten the combination or lost the key? We open safes without damage and repair faulty locking mechanisms.

about_pullquote: We answer the phone at 3am because locks don't break at 9am.
about_para_1: A1 Locksmiths has been serving Nottingham and the surrounding area for 18 years. Starting from a single van, we've built a reputation for honest pricing, rapid response, and genuine expertise. Our team are time-served locksmiths with full public liability insurance and DBS clearance.
about_para_2: We don't charge call-out fees for legitimate lockouts, and we won't upsell you services you don't need. Customers return because we turn up on time, fix the problem properly, and charge a fair rate. Whether it's midnight on a Sunday or a Tuesday morning, we're here when you need us.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Locked myself out on a Saturday evening and panicked. Called A1 and they arrived in less than an hour. Really professional, no faffing about, and the price was fair. Sorted.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had a broken lock on the back door. They popped round, replaced it properly, and didn't try to sell me anything I didn't need. That's rare these days. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Emma K.

reviews.text: Called at midnight with a smashed car window lock. They came out, fixed it without damaging anything else, and charged me a reasonable rate. Can't ask for more than that.
reviews.author: David P.

address_sub: Serving Nottingham and all surrounding areas 24/7
